process.title: Discover
process.description: Axurcio embeds with your stakeholders to find the real problem — mapping AI use cases against business value, data readiness and risk. We replay our understanding so everyone is aligned before a line of code is written.

process.title: Architect
process.description: We design the solution architecture, evaluation strategy and deployment patterns — and capture it all as template-driven, audit-ready artifacts in Arckit, with the right jurisdictional overlay applied from day one.

process.title: Build together
process.description: Embedded in your environment, Axurcio codes, debugs and deploys the bespoke agentic solution alongside your engineers — not over the fence. Governance gates run on every change through the Arckit harness.

process.title: Evaluate & harden
process.description: We stand up evals, monitoring and reliability SLOs so the system behaves in production — with full provenance and traceability for every decision and artifact.

process.title: Ship to production
process.description: We move the solution into live operations against your compliance baseline, closing the strategy-to-execution gap that stalls most AI initiatives.

process.title: Enable & hand over
process.description: We upskill your team to own and extend what we built, leaving behind documented, governed, audit-ready architecture — so capability stays in-house when the engagement ends.
